profile.headline: Chief Software Engineer at Enfav LLC
profile.summary:
Senior/Lead Full Stack Software Engineer with 10+ years delivering acquisition, ICO/token-launch, and production-critical execution across Web3, Blockchain, AdTech, TV, mobile, and enterprise platforms. Strong in TypeScript, Vue.js, React Native, Angular, Node.js, NestJS, AWS/GCP, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, event-driven architecture, and agentic AI workflow systems. Built AI automation across dev PR agents, Playwright MCP/E2E pipelines, GitHub/Jira workflows, Vision API media ops, Sanity/embedding search, and multi-agent DAG engines. Known for scaling to 10,000+ concurrent users, reducing QA burden, and shipping high-stakes platforms.

My focus is on delivering clean, efficient solutions while continuously enhancing my technical skill set to address evolving industry standards. Committed to fostering effective communication and planning, I support project success through careful organization and collaborative leadership.

positions.title: Chief Software Engineer
positions.description:
• AI Engineering & Agentic Automation: Founded an AI-focused software engineering company specializing in autonomous AI agents, LLM-powered workflows, business process automation, and intelligent software solutions.
• Multi-Agent Systems & Orchestration: Architected and developed custom agentic workflow engines integrating LLMs, tool calling, API orchestration, contextual memory, and multi-step reasoning to automate complex technical and business processes.
• Full-Stack & Cloud Architecture: Designed scalable applications and backend services using TypeScript, Node.js, React, Next.js, PostgreSQL, and AWS, focusing on modular architecture, reliability, and extensibility.
• Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG): Developed AI-powered knowledge retrieval systems leveraging vector embeddings, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and contextual grounding to improve information discovery and response quality.
• Developer Automation & AI Tooling: Built intelligent automation workflows integrating GitHub, Jira, Playwright, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to support code analysis, automated testing, development workflows, and engineering productivity.
• System Design & Intelligent Evaluation: Developed graph-based system architecture tooling incorporating AI-assisted evaluation, component modeling, and iterative design feedback to improve the quality and scalability of software systems.
• Enterprise & Government Technology Solutions: Established Enfav to develop AI automation, custom software, systems integration, and data-processing solutions for commercial and public-sector organizations.
• Technical Strategy & Business Development: Own technical architecture, product development, solution design, and business operations, including federal contractor registration and procurement opportunity identification.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Full-Stack Product Development: Designed, developed, and maintained enterprise-scale advertising technology applications using TypeScript, Angular, Node.js, and modern frontend architecture.
• Automated Testing & Quality Engineering: Built and enhanced automated end-to-end testing frameworks using Playwright and Jest, contributing to a 50% reduction in production bugs and a 60% reduction in manual QA effort.
• CI/CD & Engineering Productivity: Improved regression testing workflows, debugging processes, and automated quality checks to increase release confidence and accelerate development cycles.
• Frontend Architecture & Reusable Components: Developed reusable Angular components and dynamic UI widgets for complex advertising workflows, improving maintainability and consistency across the platform.
• Production Monitoring & Reliability: Leveraged Datadog, application logging, and automated testing to investigate defects, identify regressions, and improve production stability.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partnered with product managers, designers, QA engineers, and other developers to deliver production-ready features and resolve complex technical challenges.
• Scalable Engineering Practices: Improved code quality, test coverage, and maintainability through TypeScript development, modular architecture, code reviews, and automated validation.
• Business Impact: Contributed to the engineering evolution of Frequence's advertising technology platform through product enhancements, technical improvements, and quality initiatives during its acquisition by Madhive.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Drove full-stack engineering for Gala's collectibles, Film, and Web3 launch workflows using Vue.js and React Native TV.  
• Led the delivery of the Gala Film application, enhancing creator-to-fan media flows and digital ownership experiences.  
• Architected scalable Node.js/NestJS services on AWS/GCP, supporting over 10,000 concurrent users.
• Technical Leadership & Product Ownership: Led full-stack engineering initiatives across Gala's entertainment ecosystem, owning architecture, implementation, integrations, and production delivery for consumer-facing applications.
• Scalable Backend Architecture: Designed and developed scalable backend services using TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, MongoDB, and AWS, supporting applications serving 10,000+ concurrent users.
• Cross-Platform Development: Built and maintained applications using Vue.js, React Native TV, and TypeScript, delivering interactive experiences across web and connected-TV platforms.
• AI-Powered Automation & Intelligent Search: Integrated Google Cloud Vision API, vector embeddings, semantic search, and Sanity CMS to automate content processing, improve asset discovery, and streamline content management workflows.
• Agentic AI & Developer Productivity: Developed AI-powered engineering workflows integrating LLMs, retrieval systems, and automated tooling to improve content operations, developer productivity, and application workflows.
positions.insights: Skills: Vue.js · Node.js · TypeScript · AWS · Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Contributed to platform execution and engineering maturity that supported
Frequence’s acquisition by Madhive across omnichannel workflow and local CTV
infrastructure.
• Provided technical direction for 30+ engineers/QAs across frontend architecture,
testing strategy, design systems, PR standards, offshore coordination, and product
breakdown.
• Helped lead Frequence’s core Angular framework, building extensible widgets and
configurable UI systems for AdTech planning, activation, and reporting workflows.
• Built AI-assisted regression/E2E automation with Playwright, Jest, Claude multimodal
testing, and Datadog, reducing production bugs by 50% and manual QA by 60%.
• Automated browser validation across high-variation customer workflows, improving
release confidence for configurable, production-critical business paths

positions.title: Lead Full Stack Developer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
• Migrated AngularJS to React + TypeScript, improving architecture, testability,
design-system reuse, and product/design collaboration via Storybook.
• Built configurable dashboards for events, inventory, influencer campaigns, ticketing
operations, and white-label partner workflows.
• Optimized PostgreSQL data flows with indexing, stored procedures, triggers,
webhooks, and transactional event processing.
• Re-architected AWS ticketing services, scaling from 350 to 10,000+ concurrent users
with JWT-based service allocation.
• Raised test coverage from near-zero to 70% across a 90,000

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Vendor Portal Application - Web portal to standardize vendor tool evaluating. Tool allows collaboration, transparency, security and objectivity in tool evaluation among different evaluators in Visa.

Features: Common repository to store shared evaluations, locking mechanism to prevent merge conflicts in documents, email client for admin and evaluator communication, realtime notifications, database encryption for security, file uploads and file bundling capability to send a final report to upper management with all the supporting files, LDAP authentication to only allow Visa and privileged users access.

Technology: MEAN stack (Mongodb, Expressjs, Angularjs, NodeJs, javascript), Material Design

Techniques: Agile development and software development cycle


Network Risk Project - Built the front end and back end rails for an application that measures device risk in VISA. Made data visualization and user experience to allow Visa developers to check how much risk devices have and how careful they should be when making changes.
Made insightful graphs to be able to interpret complex back end data with applied machine learning and created grids to give relevant device information

Technology: MEAN Stack (Mongodb, Expressjs, Angularjs, NodeJs, javascript), Cassandra, Material Design, D3js

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description: Created data visualization dashboards while working closely with data science team to assess server risk within vast Visa network. Improved risk exposure discovery reduced incidences by over 30%. (d3js, React). Developed a real-time and collaborative workflow vendor portal. Reduced 3rd-party tool approval process by over 80%. (React & Node).

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Front End: Worked on a leading role in the front end team to develop a box office, data visualizations, and event ticketing configurations.

Back End: developed APIs to provide data and service company's workflow, ticket monitoring, and sales analytics.

Technology: PHP, MySQL, Angular, Javascript, Bootstrap

Techniques: Agile, daily stand ups, scrum cycle, software development cycle

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description: Built booking travel UX application that is desktop and mobile compatible.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Front End: Page development, created travelling and flight booking pages, customized UX design
Back End: password and user information encryption, input validation, and database MySQL configuration.
Testing: performed website testing for security vulnerabilities.
Technology: Python, Django, JQuery, Bootstrap, Javascript

positions.title: System Tools Team
positions.description:
Automation project - developed a self service application to provide higher efficiency at updating Visa tickets for operation and infrastructure. 

Features included: real time notifications, visual analytics of data, backend mssql database interaction, ticket validation, and user experience.

Technology: MVC .NET Framework, C#, Mssql, Angular, d3js, javascript.

Technique: Agile Development including designing, prototyping, implementing, testing, and integration.


Automation Project - developed the graphical interface of an automation application for on call scheduling.

Features included: admin configurations, user accounts, smart scheduling, messaging capability, user experience, and shift trading.

Technology: MVC .NET Framework, C#, Mssql, Angular, javascript.

positions.title: Fundraiser
positions.description:
Responsible for calling alumni, student parents, and school affiliates.

Role: To build and maintain good relationships with people involved with UC San Diego and to fund raise money for student programs and scholarships.

Accomplishment: Raised over $35,000 for the programs and scholarships.
